title: Sunset Cafe
ask_addressed: mob-tie: Capone and the Grand Terrace
quote: by now "controlled" (or 25% controlled) by Al Capone.
summary: States Capone "controlled" or held a 25 percent share of the club in 1928; the source is a 1975 TV interview with Earl Hines.
limits: The quote marks around "controlled" and the 25 percent figure show the page itself is unsure. No court or board record is cited.

title: Sunset Cafe
quote: when it was renamed the Grand Terrace Cafe.
summary: Says the 315 E 35th St building was remodelled and renamed Grand Terrace Cafe in 1937 (built 1909, club from 1921). That conflicts with a 1928 Grand Terrace opening.
limits: Page also names Joe Glaser as owner of the Sunset; it contradicts itself on when the Grand Terrace name began.

title: Sunset Cafe
quote: returned to its modest roots after the then-named–Grand Terrace Cafe closed in 1950
summary: Gives 1950 as the closing of the Grand Terrace Cafe at the 35th St building.
limits: Conflicts with the Earl Hines page, which says the Grand Terrace closed in December 1940.

title: Earl Hines
quote: The Grand Terrace Cafe had closed suddenly in December 1940; its manager, Ed Fox, disappeared.
summary: Gives December 1940 for the Grand Terrace closure and names Ed Fox as manager.
limits: Conflicts with the 1950 closing on the Sunset Cafe page. It does not say Fox answered to the Outfit.

title: Earl Hines
ask_addressed: mob-tie: Capone control of Grand Terrace
quote: The Grand Terrace was controlled by the gangster Al Capone
summary: States Capone control of the Grand Terrace as background to Hines opening there on 28 December 1928.
limits: No primary record cited here; derives from Hines interviews and Stanley Dance.
